discription: A plucked string sound using the Karplus-Strong algorithm, excited by a noise burst. Parameters control the decay time and the brightness of the tone.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, decay=2.0, brightness=0.5; var sig, exciter, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(0.001, decay, level: amp), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); exciter = WhiteNoise.ar * EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(0.001, 0.02), gate: gate, doneAction: 0); sig = CombL.ar(exciter, 0.05, 1/freq, decay * 0.95); sig = LPF.ar(sig, freq * (1 + brightness.clip(0, 1) * 3)); sig = sig * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
